name: Uralmashzavod
note: Listed as a sponsor of HC Avtomobilist on the club's sponsors page (archived 8 July 2025). Ultimate owner not established: 51% of parent UK UZTM-Kartex passed to JSC Enlil Finance in March 2022 and Enlil's shareholders are not public; 48.6% is held by the closed fund ZPIF 'Gazprombank - industrial investments'. In June 2026 a Yekaterinburg court convicted Uralmashzavod workshop chief Andrey Kharin over the 2025 death of a worker at the plant - violation of industrial safety requirements causing death by negligence (Part 2, Art. 217 of the Criminal Code; Kommersant, 11 June 2026, https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/8736832). Flagged for maintainers, not recorded as a claim.
